2026-08-21.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Linux kernel's memory policy module where mbind() operations on VM_PFNMAP regions could fail due to incorrect handling of huge page mappings. The problem arises when a PMD is installed through vmf_insert_pfn_pmd(), which leads to a folio being created in unpopulated vmemmap. The patch uses the vm_normal_folio_pmd() function to handle this case, skipping NULL returns and allowing the PTE loop in queue_folios_pte_range() to continue as usual. This fix ensures that mbind(MPOL_MF_STRICT) operations on PMD mapped VM_PFNMAP regions return 0 instead of -EIO.
